retained_invalid_scene_attempt.reason: Probe passed two arguments to the one-argument step_allowed method. Parse failure only; no scene result. Corrected before the final authored barrack probe.

interpretation: The old painted oracle used interpolated wpos, unlike the actual production view-space reconstruction. Correct production input clears all three historical pixels but retains a distinct soft perspective error. No tolerance/epsilon change or query variant is adopted.

The camera-relative derivative variant is deferred: actual production soft captures are identical, and +4096 coordinates retain widespread strict differences despite a three-pixel perspective improvement.

The first full-surface ordinary run retains the old wpos oracle edge. With production input and native normals in both material modes, the tracks prototype passes all 247 ordinary checks and all eight rain profiles.

Authored-house rain tests prove a visible copied-ground highlight inside the contact band, a zero covered-ground highlight, exact restoration and unchanged outside/upper/silhouette controls. Cover texture is diagnostic +/-10000; this is not an authored roof-placement or full terrain/figure lighting equivalence claim.

The first snow-track run has eight strict normal failures plus one invalid grass-specific noise-density assertion. The snow response is 292 pixels and track response 3135 pixels. The subsequent fixture requires a nonzero snow response while retaining >1000 for the original grass case; normal tolerance remains 0.002. Clear-magenta native holes are excluded from wet-response counts.

The unchanged-input final snow pair reduces ordinary/reversed/perspective/below strict pixels from 3379/2494/3445/2488 to 93/82/46/67. Eight strict case failures remain, also in original-material, detail-off and constant-art controls. No tolerance relaxation or precision variant is used.

One bounded readback diagnosis explains representative track-edge residuals from float-coordinate differences crossing measured texture-filter coefficient boundaries. Compression and pre-track normal agree closely; raw texels, independently fitted coefficients and captured taps reconstruct the differing slopes/normals. This is observed Forward+/RTX3090 evidence, not a universal hardware model or a proposed snapping fix.

Actual zone11 Barrack00-6 NID1651 with five controlled native footprint stamps passes 112 checks. Native placement/meshes and support are preserved. Isolating copied-ground track normals changes 1746/1389/1455 band pixels by more than 2 bytes for sun/native point/local light respectively; outside-band and restoration controls are exact. This is a fixed authored-object rendering fixture, not physical walking or full terrain/object light equivalence.

review.normal_semantics: Read-only review found native triplanar axes, reconstructed height-gradient signs, strengths and shared sampler binding consistent.
review.view_semantics: The validated mono Godot VIEW is -normalize(vertex_interp) in Forward+, Mobile and GLES, including orthographic. Do not replace the copied-ground view ray with a constant orthographic ray.
review.known_positional_light_limit: Copied highlights reconstruct view at sampled ground while LIGHT/ATTENUATION describe the object fragment. Directional direction is coherent; nearby point direction, attenuation and ground-position shadows remain approximate.

remaining: Strict footprint-edge sampling and soft-triangle precision residuals remain explicit; not full numerical parity.
Original terrain shoreline per-vertex emissive/underwater attenuation is still not reconstructed.
Nearby point/optional local light and sampled-ground shadow equivalence remain approximate.
This batch uses Forward+ only. Composed Natural/cliff/cloud/fog settings, physical walking trails, additional wall/track views and scales, other backends and device acceptance remain open.
Shader startup/steady costs remain unqualified; foreign rendered processes were observed.
unchanged: Canonical production, delivered Linux/Windows .2 packages, settings defaults and user saves/profiles are unchanged by these scratch prototypes.
